messages:
Sam (AM): quick one — we have a Dedicated POC deal (customer: Acme Health) asking for 45% off rate card for a 6-month commit. Can we fast-path this? need routing rules if <50% and commit <12mo.

Maya - DealDesk: Put it through FastPath only if Discount_Tier__c <= 40 and Annual_Recurring_Value >= $50k. 45% triggers manual review. :thinking_face:

Jasper (AE): customer is small org but sensitive data. they want Private deployment. ARR estimate ~38k over 6mo (rough).

Lina - RevOps: ARR < 50k so FastPath shouldn't apply under current policy. We have two flows: POC flow and Standard flow. Current CPQ rule snippet:
```
if Discount_Tier__c <= 40 && ARR >= 50000 then route -> FastPath
else route -> StandardDealDesk
```

Maya - DealDesk: For POCs we also check `POC_Only__c`. If true and commit <= 6mo, DealDesk can grant a one-time override up to 35% via FastPath (AM + DealDesk sign-off). 45% still needs manual queue.

Ken - Legal: Private deployment + sensitive data => security questionnaire and enclave addendum required. Legal must approve Special_Terms__c for any VPC/on-prem work. No fast-tracking on legal.

Sam (AM): customer pushing 45. They said they can extend to 9 months — would that push ARR over the threshold?

Jasper (AE): rough numbers: list_monthly = $10k. 6mo list = $60k, but they asked off list. If we do 9mo at 35% discount our ARR-equivalent crosses $50k. I'll put exact numbers in CPQ.

Maya - DealDesk: Please populate CPQ fields before routing: `Commitment_Length__c`, `Discount_Tier__c`, `POC_Only__c`, `Customer_Segment__c`. Also check `Approval_Level__c` (1 = auto, 2 = dealdesk, 3 = exec). Anything >2 goes to manual review.

Sam (AM): done — draft attached in SFDC: https://salesforce.example.com/12345 (pooled access).

Lina - RevOps: suggestion: add a Gatekeeper boolean `Gatekeeper_Override__c` that surfaces flagged deals to a DealDesk fast-queue with an explicit reason field. If set, SLA = 48h for DealDesk response. Also add `Private_Deployment__c` check that blocks auto-approvals.

Maya - DealDesk: agree. We'll update FastPath policy and CPQ mapping. New checks: `POC_Only__c == true && Discount_Tier__c <= 35 && Private_Deployment__c == false` -> same-day FastPath. Otherwise StandardDealDesk (48-72h) + Legal if Private.

Ken - Legal: I'll prepare a short enclave addendum template and SQ checklist. Once we get completed SQ answers, Legal ETA 72h for review (can try to expedite if narrow scope).

Sam (AM): customer wants PO by end of week. Can we compress Legal/DealDesk cycles?

Maya - DealDesk: If AE can get `POC_Only__c = true` and reduce requested discount to <=35% we can FastPath same day. If not, Standard queue 48-72h and Legal adds 72h. So ask AE to aim for 35% + 9mo.

Jasper (AE): I'll push for 9mo at 35% and gather SQ answers today. Sam — can you confirm they will accept 9mo? :pray:

dealbot: New DealDesk ticket created: DD-78912, assigned to Maya - DealDesk. SLA: 48h.

Sam (AM): thanks all. looped in Ken - Legal and Lina - RevOps on the ticket. Will report back when customer confirms 9mo/answers. :thumbsup:
